title: RLAIF vs. RLHF: Scaling Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback with AI Feedback
authors_zh: Harrison Lee、Samrat Phatale、Hassan Mansoor、Thomas Mesnard、Johan Ferret、Kellie Lu、Colton Bishop、Ethan Hall、Victor Carbune、Abhinav Rastogi、Sushant Prakash（Google Research）
paper_type_zh: AI 反馈替代人工偏好数据的强化学习对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要扩展偏好标签供给、比较奖励模型与直接奖励接口的读者。
one_line: RLAIF trains alignment systems from LLM-generated feedback and compares reward-model and direct-reward variants with human-feedback RL.
RLAIF 用现成语言模型生成偏好反馈，并比较经奖励模型训练与直接获取 AI 奖励的两条强化学习路径。
why: It makes the feedback labeler a scalable, replaceable training component rather than a human-only bottleneck.
inclusion_reason: Demonstrates how AI-generated preferences can replace human preference labels in a reward-model and policy-optimization pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html:
RLHF relies on high-quality human preference labels, but collecting them is expensive and slow. A reward model trained only once also fixes the quality and coverage of the feedback used by later policy optimization.

The paper asks whether an off-the-shelf language model can provide the preference signal instead. It compares the usual route—train a reward model from AI labels—with a route that obtains rewards directly from the AI labeler during reinforcement learning.

RLHF 依赖高质量人工偏好标签，但收集它们成本高且速度慢。只训练一次的奖励模型也会固定后续策略优化所能使用的反馈质量和覆盖范围。

论文要问的是，现成语言模型能否改为提供偏好信号。它比较了通常路径——从 AI 标签训练奖励模型——和一种在强化学习期间直接从 AI 标注器获得奖励的路径。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
RLAIF changes the producer of preference data, not the basic downstream alignment objective. An LLM judges candidate responses, and its choices either train a reward model or act directly as reward information for the policy learner.

This makes feedback scale with access to a capable labeler rather than with human annotation throughput. It also separates two decisions that are often conflated: whether feedback is human or AI generated, and whether it is compressed into a learned reward model before policy optimization.

RLAIF 改变的是偏好数据的生产者，而不是基本的下游对齐目标。语言模型评判候选回答，它的选择要么训练奖励模型，要么直接作为策略学习器的奖励信息。

这使反馈规模取决于能否使用有能力的标注器，而非人工标注吞吐量。它也分离了两个常被混淆的决定：反馈是人类生成还是 AI 生成，以及在策略优化前是否把反馈压缩为学习到的奖励模型。

title: Method
方法
html:
For canonical RLAIF, an LLM labels response preferences and a reward model learns from those labels before the policy is optimized. For direct-RLAIF, the policy receives reward judgments directly from the off-the-shelf LLM during RL, avoiding a separate reward-model training stage.

The paper evaluates the alternatives on summarization, helpful dialogue, and harmless dialogue. It also tests a self-improvement setting in which the AI labeler is the same size as, or even the same initial checkpoint as, the policy being improved.

在标准 RLAIF 中，语言模型标注回答偏好，奖励模型从这些标签中学习，再优化策略。对于直接 RLAIF，策略在强化学习期间直接从现成语言模型获得奖励判断，避免单独的奖励模型训练阶段。

论文在摘要、帮助性对话和无害性对话上评估这些方案。它还测试一种自我提升设定，其中 AI 标注器与待提升策略大小相同，甚至就是该策略的初始检查点。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the reported tasks, RLAIF reaches performance comparable to RLHF. The direct-RLAIF variant is reported to outperform canonical RLAIF, and the self-improvement experiment outperforms a supervised fine-tuned baseline under the tested conditions.

These results show that AI feedback can be a viable training signal in the studied settings. They do not establish that an AI judge matches people on every value-laden judgment, or that direct use of a changing external model remains reproducible without logging its version and prompt.

在报告的各项任务中，RLAIF 达到与 RLHF 相近的表现。直接 RLAIF 变体被报告为优于标准 RLAIF，而在所测试条件下，自我提升实验超过了监督微调基线。

这些结果表明，在所研究的设定中，AI 反馈可以成为可行训练信号。它们并未证明 AI 评审器会在人类价值判断的所有情形中与人一致，也未证明不记录版本和提示时，直接使用不断变化的外部模型仍可复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier RLAIF work established AI feedback as a possibility; this paper systematically compares it with RLHF across several alignment tasks and distinguishes reward-model-mediated feedback from direct AI rewards during RL. The latter moves the external judge from data preparation into the optimization loop.

The important data-lifecycle contribution is the explicit choice of feedback consumer. The same kind of AI judgment can be stored as a label for a reward model or queried online as policy reward, producing different costs, reproducibility properties, and opportunities for feedback drift.

较早的 RLAIF 工作已证明 AI 反馈的可能性；本文在多个对齐任务上系统比较它与 RLHF，并区分经奖励模型传递的反馈和强化学习期间直接使用的 AI 奖励。后者把外部评审器从数据准备环节移入优化循环。

其重要的数据生命周期贡献，是明确选择反馈的使用方。同一种 AI 判断既可以作为奖励模型的存储标签，也可以在线查询为策略奖励，从而产生不同的成本、可复现性和反馈漂移机会。

title: Limitations
局限
html: AI labels inherit the labeler’s biases and may be prompt- or version-sensitive, while direct-RLAIF makes training dependent on repeated external reward queries. Reward hacking, cost, service changes, and a mismatch between AI judgments and target users can all weaken the apparent replacement of human feedback.
AI 标签会继承标注器的偏见，也可能对提示或版本敏感；直接 RLAIF 使训练依赖反复的外部奖励查询。奖励投机、成本、服务变更以及 AI 判断与目标用户不一致，都可能削弱“替代人工反馈”的表面效果。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when deciding how an AI judge should enter an alignment system: as an offline preference annotator, as a teacher for a reward model, or as an online reward provider. It is especially useful for designing the provenance log needed to make AI feedback inspectable across labeler versions and policy iterations.
当需要决定 AI 评审器如何进入对齐系统时，可使用本文：作为离线偏好标注器、奖励模型的教师，或在线奖励提供者。它尤其适合设计所需的来源日志，使 AI 反馈能跨越标注器版本和策略迭代被检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Track the exact judge model, prompt, decoding settings, task split, and whether rewards were stored or queried online. The comparison between RLAIF and direct-RLAIF should be read as an interface comparison as well as a score comparison: it changes which component sees the raw AI judgment.
应记录确切的评审模型、提示、解码设置、任务划分，以及奖励是被保存还是在线查询。RLAIF 与直接 RLAIF 的比较既是接口比较，也是分数比较：它改变了哪个组件能够看到原始 AI 判断。
